F#3 bars of 5.0-, 4.5-, 4.3- and 4.0-octave marimbas; instrument models are not stated
unstated; measured by 2019 (ISMA 2019, Detmold); the Premier bar is 'much older' than the rest (p. 86)
free undercut marimba bar: vertical flexural modes tuned near 1 : 4 : 10, with untuned torsional and lateral-torsional modes

the bar rests on small foam blocks under its two bored cord holes; a Bruel and Kjaer Type 8203 impact hammer strikes a grid on the playing surface, and a Polytec PDV-100 laser Doppler vibrometer reads the bottom surface near a corner (p. 85)

SEVEN measured commercial F#3 bars, outer dimensions and mass only: a check of a marimba card's borrowed outline and of a solved undercut's bar mass at F#3. The undercut is printed only as photographs (Fig. 2, three bars), so this table fixes no undercut, and no bar here is the Iowa recording's bar
